dct_creator_sm: Donnan, Jennifer (Memorial University of Newfoundland). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2908-0804
dct_description_sm: This survey includes four discrete choice experiments (DCE) that were done in accordance with the general framework for good research practices. Each DCE included 6-8 choice tasks, each looking at different cannabis purchase decisions. These included three product types: dried flower, edible and vapes, and the choice of cannabis retailer.
dct_title_s: Consumer preferences for attributes of cannabis products and retailers: A series of Discrete Choice Experiments
